name: combined-astro-starter-kit
description: Combined ApostropheCMS plus Astro starter kit

scripts.postinstall: pnpm run install-frontend && pnpm run install-backend && echo '\n💡 combined pnpm install complete'
scripts.install-frontend: cd frontend && echo '\n💡 running pnpm install in frontend/' && pnpm install
scripts.install-backend: cd backend && echo '\n💡 running pnpm install in backend/' && pnpm install
scripts.update: pnpm run update-frontend && pnpm run update-backend && echo '\n💡 combined pnpm update complete'
scripts.update-frontend: cd frontend && echo '\n💡 running pnpm update in frontend/' && pnpm update
scripts.update-backend: cd backend && echo '\n💡 running pnpm update in backend/' && pnpm update
scripts.build: pnpm run build-frontend && pnpm run build-backend && echo '\n💡 combined pnpm build complete'
scripts.build-frontend: cd frontend && echo '\n💡 running pnpm run build in frontend/' && pnpm run build
scripts.build-backend: cd backend && echo '\n💡 running pnpm run build in backend/' && pnpm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

author: Apostrophe Technologies Inc.
